name: context-triage
description: Find what is filling my agent’s context and remove the waste without losing decisions. Use supplied traces, configuration and files to identify context contributors or prepare a smaller continuation pack with source references. No accounts or API keys required.

interface.longDescription: Find what is filling my agent’s context and remove the waste without losing decisions. Use supplied traces, configuration and files to identify context contributors or prepare a smaller continuation pack with source references. No accounts or API keys required.
defaultPrompt: Why does this session compact so often? Here are the trace and config.
Prepare a smaller context pack for this next task from the files I provide.
